resultJson.title: Fix Scala compilation warnings
resultJson.body:
- Remove unused imports in `API.scala`, `Endpoints.scala` and `Main.scala`.
- Use Scala 3 syntax: `?` instead of `_` for wildcard types and imports, and `A & B` instead of `A with B` in the `run` return type of `Main`.

No behaviour changes.

The diff also adds `.orca/settings.properties` and an `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` file, which are orca tooling files and not part of the code fix.
